text:
mira: quick heads up — HealthCorp POC stuck: logs missing trace_id for some worker processes and they9re seeing intermittent 429s on the HTTP drain. Need an SE/SRE pair to triage before afternoon demo.

sam: on it. Are they using our HTTP drain or the console9s forwarder?

mira: HTTP drain to Sysdig. Missing trace ids appear in cron-like/background jobs. 429 spikes when they run batch reingests. they also asked about removing PII before export.

alex: background jobs usually lose request context. two quick checks: 1) ensure the trace header is attached when you enqueue jobs; 2) in workers call `redwood.context.propagate()` at job start if using our SDK. snippet:```python
# enqueue from request handler
trace = request.headers.get('x-redwood-trace')
job = {'user': uid, 'payload': body}
enqueue(job, headers={'x-redwood-trace': trace})
```
worker side:```python
from redwood import context
context.propagate(request.headers.get('x-redwood-trace'))
# now logs will include trace_id
```

jen: can we get a live-tail link to watch during the call?

alex: yes — use the project live-tail and filter by the token. example: https://console.redwood.ai/projects/healthcorp/live-tail . I'll also bump their drain quota temporarily.

alex: 429s are almost always ingest-side rate limits or transient network. our drain client does 3 retries with backoff. options: increase Sysdig ingest quota, enable buffering on their collector, or we temporarily raise the drain allowance on our side for the POC. i can raise for 2 hours.

carl: for PII/redaction we support export transforms you can configure in Console -> Exports -> Transformations. short example YAML to remove fields + redact:```yaml
- remove_field: ssn

- redact_regex:
    pattern: "(?i)password\\s*[:=]\\s*\\S+"
    replace_with: "[REDACTED]"
```
we can also add a compliance note on the export config for their auditors.

mira: can someone run an 11:00am PT session to reproduce and confirm? want to see a trace go end-to-end and verify no 429s during burst test. @sam @alex

sam: i9ll run the walkthrough and coordinate creds. alex, can you toggle the drain quota now?

alex: done. bumped `hpoc-sysdig` drain quota 120->300 req/s for 2h. monitoring tail for errors.

deploy-bot: Quota update applied: `hpoc-sysdig` drain_rate 120->300 req/s by alex at 1959876789 UTC.

alex: sending them a reproducible curl they can run from their dev box so we can catch a unique trace in live-tail:```bash
curl -s -H "x-redwood-trace: HC-DBG-$(date +%s)" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"noop"}'
```
then search live-tail for HC-DBG- token.

sam: i9ll also prepare a short checklist and share in the drive: [verify trace appears in live-tail, run 100 req burst, confirm zero 429s during window, agree on export transform].

mira: perfect. i9ll lock the 11am slot and share the invite + live-tail link. after the session, if trace shows up and 429s stop we9ll mark resolved. otherwise we escalate to eng-oncall. :thumbsup:

alex: one more note: if they9re using older SDKs, there's a known header name mismatch (x-redwood-trace vs x-rd-trace) — check both on the wire.

carl: and for long-term we can offer buffered forwarder as part of Dedicated or Private so bursts don9t hit third-party quotas.

mira: thanks all. tagging the security contact to review the redaction snippet during the call.
